description: Rewrite a text in a chosen tone (neutral, formal, casual, simple, persuasive) and length (shorter, same, longer), keeping its meaning and language. Up to 3 variants. Workers AI (Llama 3.3 70B) writes the rewrite; only the rewritten text is returned. Up to 8,000 characters. The model can change nuance, so read the result. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
